items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: So I went down there and I met all these people... Dave Bargeron... And so Howard Johnson and I hit it off... I started playing with Gil Evans for the last 15 years of Gil’s life.

ctx.x: Yes I saw him in Rochester.

So one night Hannibal says, “I got two gigs tonight.” He said, “The gig with Gil Evans doesn’t pay anything. You want to sub for me with Gil Evans?” And I said sure. So I went down there and I met all these people, it changed the rest of my life. Howard Johnson, David Sanborn, Dave Bargeron, Lew Soloff, Bruce Ditmus, on and on and on. And so Howard Johnson and I hit it off because you know I play tuba and a lot of instruments, like he did. And he recommended me — I mean playing with Gil Evans that night I started…
Guess who I was speaking with an hour ago on the phone? Fred Lipsius.
